common.sentTo: This email was sent to {{email}} by {{instance}}.
common.fallback: Button not working? Paste this link into your browser:

digest.reason: You get these because mention emails are on for you in {{workspace}}.

reset.subject: Reset your {{instance}} password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Somebody asked to reset the password for {{email}} on {{instance}}.
reset.expiry: The link works once and expires in an hour.
reset.notYou: If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

code.subject: {{code}} is your {{instance}} sign-in code
code.heading: Your sign-in code
code.body: Enter this code to sign in to {{instance}}:
code.expiry_one: It works once and expires in {{count}} minute.
code.expiry_other: It works once and expires in {{count}} minutes.
code.notYou: If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

sso.subject: Sign in to {{instance}} with SSO
sso.heading: You sign in with SSO
sso.body: Somebody asked for a way into this account on {{instance}}.
sso.how: This account signs in with single sign-on, so it has no password to reset and no sign-in code. Open {{instance}} and choose Sign in with SSO.
sso.notYou: If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

inviteExpired.subject: Your invitation to {{workspace}} has expired
inviteExpired.heading: Your invitation has expired
inviteExpired.body: Somebody asked for a way into this account on {{instance}}.
inviteExpired.workspace: Your invitation to {{workspace}} has expired, so there is no way in yet. Ask an admin of {{workspace}} to invite you again, and open the link in that email.
inviteExpired.noWorkspace: Your invitation has expired, so there is no way in yet. Ask an admin of the workspace that invited you to invite you again, and open the link in that email.

invite.subject: Join {{workspace}} on {{instance}}
invite.heading: Join {{workspace}}
invite.body: {{inviter}} invited you to the {{workspace}} workspace on {{instance}}.
invite.bodyRequested: {{inviter}} invited you to the {{workspace}} workspace on {{instance}}, at {{requester}}'s request.
invite.bodyNoInviter: You've been invited to the {{workspace}} workspace on {{instance}}.
invite.notExpected: If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.

inviteRequest.subject: {{requester}} asks you to invite people to {{workspace}}
inviteRequest.heading: A request to invite people
inviteRequest.bodyMember: {{requester}} asked for an invite to {{workspace}} for {{emails}}, as members.
inviteRequest.bodyGuest: {{requester}} asked for an invite to {{workspace}} for {{emails}}, as guests.
inviteRequest.expiry: If nobody answers it within 30 days, the request expires.

test.subject: Test email from {{instance}}
test.heading: Email works
test.body: This is a test email from {{instance}}. It reached you, so email works.

unsubscribePage.title: Mention emails
unsubscribePage.explain: You will still see your mentions and direct messages in the app.
unsubscribePage.again: You can turn them back on in Preferences → Notifications.
unsubscribePage.invalid: This link doesn't work any more. You can change your emails in Preferences → Notifications.
